description: Product Highlights As a professional tradesperson, you need tools that are easy to use and meet all legal requirements. With the BOSCH Professional VDE cable shears, you can dismantle and cut wires, even if you unexpectedly make contact with live parts. This standard-compliant tool is insulated with Thermoplastic Polyurethanes (TPU). It has been tested up to 10,000 volts and VDE-certified up to 1,000 volts according to DIN EN/IEC 60900. You will find the VDE cable shears convenient and versatile. With its twin blade technology, you can use the first blade for dismantling and the second for cutting the wire. These durable shears are made of forged steel and have hardened cutting edges. With VDE hand tools added to our BOSCH Professional range, you get all your tool requirements in reliable BOSCH quality. Equipment & Application Use these robust cable shears to dismantle wires and cut aluminium and soft copper, AWG 2/0 with a cross section of up to 70 mm² and an outer diameter of 20 mm thanks to twin blade technology. Comfortable to use with an ergonomic soft grip.
